races.paceDynamic: Star Artist will take the field along from the front with no obvious early challenger, setting a sustainable gallop over this 1m4f trip. La Tosca may sit closer than usual given the lack of pace, while Prizeland and Keep It Cool will settle towards the rear as hold-up horses. The modest early tempo will create a sprint finish where horses with tactical speed and finishing kick hold the advantage. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late acceleration.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Star Artist sets modest fractions and the pace quickens late
scenarios.body: The sustainable early gallop allows closers to conserve energy before unleashing their finishing kick in the final two furlongs. Prizeland and Keep It Cool are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner gets away
scenarios.trigger: If Star Artist faces no early pressure and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Star Artist to dictate terms completely and steal a decisive advantage before the closers can respond. His stamina at this trip proves the difference in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate pace benefits all
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo remains steady throughout without dramatic acceleration
scenarios.body: The even gallop creates an honest test where class rather than tactics determines the outcome. All runners get their preferred trip setup but form and ability become the decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical collapse scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Star Artist goes too slow early then multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The crawling pace creates a messy sprint finish where positioning and luck in running become crucial. The race becomes a lottery with any of the four capable of capitalizing on the right passage.

watchPoints.text: Star Artist setting fractions that are too slow early, allowing hold-up horses perfect conditions to pounce
Keep It Cool's tendency to fade in the finish recurring despite the favorable pace setup
La Tosca's positioning early will reveal her true running style and tactical intentions
Prizeland getting too far back if the pace is genuinely modest, leaving too much ground to make up
Christian Howarth's 3lb claim potentially making the difference for Keep It Cool in a tight finish

races.paceDynamic: Okiru and Grand Echo are confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead in this 11-runner handicap over 7f. With two pace-setters likely to engage, they'll create an honest gallop that should suit horses with tactical speed who can position prominently without burning energy in the early battle. The presence of several prominent runners (Mighty Vega, Victory Ace, Sand Lily) suggests a competitive pace throughout, while the hold-up horses may struggle if the gallop becomes stop-start after the early pace clash. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can avoid the early skirmish but stay within striking distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Honest Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Okiru and Grand Echo maintain their duel for 4-5 furlongs creating steady sectionals
scenarios.body: The even pace allows prominent runners to travel smoothly and time their challenges perfectly. Hold-up horses get the strong pace they need but those with tactical speed from good positions dominate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If one front runner dominates early leaving the other struggling by halfway
scenarios.body: The winner settles into an uncontested lead creating a tactical affair that becomes a sprint finish. Late closers get their perfect scenario with patient rides paying off.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Early Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge for the lead with Sand Lily and Victory Ace joining the pace battle
scenarios.body: The frantic early pace creates gaps and positioning problems that benefit those who avoid trouble. Horses drawn well who can slot in behind the chaos hold key advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Okiru or Grand Echo establishes clear supremacy and kicks for home unchallenged
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds momentum that becomes impossible to peg back in the closing stages. Those who pressed early pay for their efforts while the winner controls completely.

watchPoints.text: Grand Echo may fold quickly if pressured early given his exposed maiden status and tendency to weaken
Victory Ace returning from 130-day absence after gelding operation could need this run despite course form
Okiru in first-time cheekpieces showed improvement last time and stall 10 may help him control the early pace
Based has shown a pattern of fading in the finish which could be costly if the pace sets up for a sprint
Roccobear's dramatic improvement for new trainer J R Jenkins makes him interesting at likely big odds

races.paceDynamic: Lordsbridge Bay will be the sole dedicated pace-setter from the gates, with this prominent runner likely to get an uncontested lead in a field dominated by hold-up horses. The lack of early pace pressure means Lordsbridge Bay can dictate comfortable fractions through the first half-mile. With 10 of 12 runners showing hold-up tendencies, the rear division will be crowded and reliant on the pace collapsing. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early, as the hold-up brigade face a tactical nightmare.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Lordsbridge Bay gets soft early fractions and maintains energy for the finish
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to control the race completely, making it extremely difficult for the massed hold-up horses to reel him in. Lordsbridge Bay's recent form improvement and step up in trip perfectly suits this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Lordsbridge Bay goes too fast early or multiple horses press for the lead
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and the front-runners weaken dramatically in the final furlong. This creates a cavalry charge finish that heavily favours the strongest hold-up horses with the best closing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If Lordsbridge Bay sets sensible fractions but lacks the class to hold off all challengers
scenarios.body: The race develops into a fair test where early position matters but doesn't guarantee success. Hold-up horses with tactical pace like Denby's Dream can position closer and still finish strongly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos From Poor Starts
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses miss the break or get shuffled back from wide draws
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery with horses having to navigate around traffic problems. Only horses with luck in running and strong finishing kicks can overcome positional disadvantages.

watchPoints.text: Lordsbridge Bay must be monitored for early pace judgement - if he goes too fast early the race completely changes complexion
Watch for any hold-up horses who break alertly and can secure midfield positions rather than getting trapped at the back
Denby's Dream's headgear and hood combination has improved him here before, watch for confident early positioning
Multiple horses returning from lengthy breaks including Raspoutine (241 days) and My Old Mate (207 days) need market confidence
Track Sail On Sailor's finishing kick - his recent Kempton run suggests he's the most progressive hold-up horse in the field

races.paceDynamic: Epictetus will lead uncontested through sensible fractions, with five prominent runners (Bravo Zulu, Arctician, Mr Baloo, Criminal, Warning Sign) creating a congested second rank behind him. This congestion will intensify approaching the home turn as these prominent horses jostle for position, likely causing interference and forcing wide moves. The combination of a solo leader setting his own tempo and traffic problems behind strongly favours front-runners and hold-up horses who can navigate around the carnage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Epictetus Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Epictetus maintains his lead and the prominent pack gets tangled up 2f out
scenarios.body: The leader capitalizes on his positional advantage while the chasing pack compromise each other's chances through interference and wide moves. Hold-up horses benefit from the strong pace but may struggle to make up the deficit.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners create severe interference approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The congested second rank causes multiple horses to be shuffled back or forced wide, allowing patient hold-up horses to thread through gaps or sweep around the outside. Fresh horses with tactical speed benefit most from the strong pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mr Baloo Emerges Late
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Baloo can secure the best position from the prominent group and avoid trouble
scenarios.body: His recent second to Helm Rock suggests he's back in form, and if he can stay clear of interference while tracking Epictetus, he has the class to strike late. The Hannon stable's 8-day turnaround indicates confidence.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Epictetus goes too slowly and the prominent pack stays together without interference
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 3f out with multiple horses still in contention, favouring those with the best finishing kick regardless of early position. Speed horses with tactical pace benefit most.

watchPoints.text: Bravo Zulu's stalls behavior - if he rears again like last time he'll be out of contention immediately
Traffic jam developing 2f out as five prominent runners converge - expect multiple horses to suffer interference
Epictetus's fractions through first half-mile - if too slow the prominent pack won't string out sufficiently
Mr Baloo's settling - if he pulls hard early from prominent position he'll compromise his finishing kick
Elouise's Prince's pulling tendencies early - headstrong horse but the strong pace should help him settle better

races.paceDynamic: Bergamo Gold stands alone as the confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead with Pangbourne the only other horse showing prominent tendencies. This creates a sustainable pace scenario where Bergamo Gold can dictate terms without early pressure, allowing the pace to build gradually through the middle stages. With five hold-up horses including Lady Milton, Grey Sands, and Heart Sign all needing to be delivered late, there's significant risk of traffic problems and horses getting stuck behind the pace. This race shape strongly favours the early pace-setters who can avoid the late scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Bergamo Gold gets a soft lead and maintains kick
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to control fractions and have enough left to resist late challengers. Hold-up horses face traffic and timing issues in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and turn of foot matter most, allowing the best closer to time their run perfectly. Lady Milton's back-to-back wins show she has the quality to capitalise.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Pangbourne can track Bergamo Gold and outkick late
scenarios.body: The Roger Teal-trained filly gets the perfect trip in behind the leader and uses her recent Wolverhampton second form to strike in the final furlong. Her prominent style avoids the hold-up horse traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Bergamo Gold goes too slow and multiple closers get there
scenarios.body: A messy finish where positioning becomes crucial and the race turns into a lottery among the hold-up horses. Heart Sign's stamina questions and Chhota Saab's poor form make this unlikely to produce a strong winner.

watchPoints.text: Bergamo Gold getting too soft a lead early - if fractions are pedestrian he becomes very hard to peg back

Traffic problems for hold-up horses Heart Sign, Chhota Saab and Grey Sands if they get boxed in turning for home
Pangbourne's positioning behind Bergamo Gold - needs to stay within striking distance without getting too keen
Grey Sands settling in cheekpieces - any signs of pulling or fighting the headgear negates his finishing kick

races.paceDynamic: Daisy Roots will likely take them along from the front with Bella Bisbee and Profit Street tracking in prominent positions, but without serious early pressure this sets up a sustainable gallop. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Twirler, Chola Empire, Zubaru, Bold Suitor, and Chifa will be looking to time their runs from the rear. With one confirmed front runner and multiple prominent types, the pace should be genuine but not frantic over this 7f trip. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a turn of foot in the final two furlongs, as the front runners will be vulnerable to late closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Late Closers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too honest and the front runners weaken
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses will have perfect conditions to unleash their finishing kicks with the leaders coming back to them in the final furlong. Multiple closers will surge late with the winner emerging from the pack.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Win
scenarios.trigger: If Profit Street or Bella Bisbee can dictate from a handy position
scenarios.body: They can control the tempo better than the outright leader and have enough left to resist the late challenge. The race becomes a battle between the prominent runners and the closer who times it best.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Daisy Roots gets an easy lead and quickens approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows her to conserve energy and she can kick clear when the closers are still organizing their challenge. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If nobody wants to make the running and the pace becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint finish where early positioning matters more than running style. The most talented horse on the day wins regardless of tactics.

watchPoints.text: Daisy Roots may get too easy a lead if prominent runners don't press early enough allowing her to dictate completely

Profit Street's hat-trick form gives him tactical speed to overcome any pace scenario from prominent position
